title: FLA serialization: full round-trip test suite
description: Add comprehensive tests for FLA save/load round-trips in packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/roundtrip.test.ts. Tests should create FlashDocument objects with various features and verify they survive a saveFla()/loadFla() round-trip with identical values: (1) Basic document properties (width, height, fps, background color, ruler units); (2) Multiple scenes with names; (3) Layer stack (multiple layers with names, types, visibility, lock, outline); (4) Keyframes with display objects (shapes, text, bitmaps, symbol instances); (5) Motion tween settings (ease, rotate, orientToPath); (6) Library items: BitmapItem with dataUri, SoundItem with dataUri, Symbol with nested timeline; (7) Document guides and grid settings; (8) Symbol linkage properties; (9) Large documents (100 frames, 10 layers) serialize/deserialize in under 500ms; (10) Missing asset entry throws descriptive error. Only touches packages/core/src/ test files — no production code changes unless bugs are found (fix them if found).
